peerDiscrepancies.dwg2Spec: Declares value group 290 and the companion field with DXF group 0.
peerDiscrepancies.dynapiGeneratorAndMetadata: The generator special-cases VISUALSTYLE *_int fields to group 176; generated metadata reports group 176.
peerDiscrepancies.dxfImporter: Reads value group 90 and companion group 176.
peerDiscrepancies.assessment: The spec declaration, generated API metadata, and DXF importer disagree on the value group and one declarative companion mapping. These source paths do not by themselves establish what the active LibreDWG runtime emits.
peerDiscrepancies.requiredAction: Inspect and execute a pinned LibreDWG writer, then compare with producer-authored ASCII/binary DXF and independent readback; test default and non-default values.

peerDiscrepancies.dxfImporter: Primary Boolean read is commented out; only the group-176 companion is read.
peerDiscrepancies.assessment: The peer importer omits this primary Boolean despite the spec and generated metadata assigning it group 290; runtime output/readback was not tested.
peerDiscrepancies.requiredAction: Require non-default producer witness and parse/write/readback comparison before selecting a local encoding policy.

peerDiscrepancies.dwg2SpecWriter: Uses candidate DXF groups 177, 291 and 70 respectively; group 70 is a second contextual use after the property-tail boundary.
peerDiscrepancies.dxfImporter: The dynamic-property reader supplies fallback ext_lighting_model values when absent; the R2013b reader requires num_props 58; group-176 companions are consumed in property order.
peerDiscrepancies.assessment: This profile has defaults and contextual tag reuse that a name/type-only serializer would miss. The Autodesk page does not describe the extended profile.
peerDiscrepancies.requiredAction: Preserve source values/provenance separately from peer defaults, validate subclass/291 boundaries, and refuse unqualified target profiles.

slotEvidence.indexing: Zero-based R2010b first 28 slots followed by R2013b slots 28-57; ordering follows the local DWG parser and LibreDWG dwg2.spec.
slotEvidence.primitiveLegend: B=bit; BS=bit-short; BL=bit-long; BD=bit-double; CMC=DWG color; T=variable text. The local source reader uses version-specific primitive variants for some fields (notably faceModifier, edge widths, halo gap, isolines, style apply, and brightness).
slotEvidence.companionLegend: The local AC1024+ DWG parser captures one bit-short companion immediately after every property. For VisualStyle, LibreDWG's generated API metadata maps *_int companions to group 176; dwg2.spec declares group 0 for indices 31 and 33 while its importer expects 176. The active writer's actual emitted tags remain unverified.
